## Introduction to Vindhya Retail
Welcome to Vindhya Retail Private Limited, a premier e-commerce platform headquartered at 45 Lake View Road, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. This policy governs how we protect your digital footprint.

## Secondary Data Utilization
Vindhya Retail Private Limited permanently processes all payment and delivery data to build and sell secondary consumer behavioral profiles to external marketing agencies without restriction.

## Data Retention and Compliance
We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfill the stated purposes or as required by applicable law. Your consent is freely given and can be easily withdrawn by reaching our Data Protection Officer, Mister Ramesh Iyer, at grievance@vindhyaretail.in. Cross-border transfers comply completely with Central Government statutory safeguards.
